negative_findings.description: No confirmation that major SK banks expose standard third-party ATS endpoints (Workday myworkdayjobs.com, SmartRecruiters jobs.smartrecruiters.com/<company>, SuccessFactors career sites) for Slovak entities.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches in en surfaced only generic SmartRecruiters/Indeed landing pages; observed SK bank ATS are local (topjobs.sk, kariera.tatrabanka.sk, vub.sk, csob.jobs.cz/LMC).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Machine-readable ATS JSON endpoints would enable cheap structured collection; their apparent absence means collection must target HTML career pages and boards instead.

negative_findings.description: Praca.sk and Robota.sk were probed as SK job boards but did not surface as live, distinct portals in results.
negative_findings.result_summary: Queries returned Profesia, Kariera.sk (Zoznam), Worki.sk and the government portal instead; no evidence retrieved for praca.sk/robota.sk current status.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Two seed-named boards may be defunct or merged (SK board market consolidated under Alma Career/Profesia); the collection plan should not assume they exist without verification.

negative_findings.description: No SK-language recruiting presence found for Worldline, Nexi, or card-scheme offices (Visa/Mastercard) in Slovakia during this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: sk query mixing 'platobné', 'nábor' and vendor names returned only Global Payments (CZ/SK) and generic pages.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Payments-vendor hiring is a leading indicator of terminal/acquiring programmes; the absence of a SK-language channel means these must be tracked via English group ATS or CZ boards.

negative_findings.description: LinkedIn jobs pages for SK banks are login-gated and ToS-restricted.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only public teaser pages appear in search; no automated collection attempted.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The richest source for leadership moves and senior hiring cannot be collected programmatically; budget for manual analyst review or licensed data.

coverage_gaps.description: Several SK banking/payments actors have no identified hiring channel yet: Slovenská záručná a rozvojová banka, Poštová banka (post-365 rebrand entity), mBank/Fio/Oberbank/J&T Banka SK branches, and PSD2 licensed payment institutions / e-money institutions registered with NBS.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate NBS's register of banks, branches, payment institutions and e-money institutions, then map each entity to a careers URL and a Profesia employer C-ID.

coverage_gaps.description: Payments-infrastructure vendors and processors operating in SK (ATM/POS estate, card personalisation, switch operators, e.g. Diebold Nixdorf, NCR/NCR Voyix, Printec, Monet+, Nexi, Worldline) are not yet mapped to hiring channels.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run sk+en queries per vendor name plus 'kariéra/voľné pozície/Bratislava' and register their ATS or Profesia employer pages.

coverage_gaps.description: Vacancy disappearance (a wind-down signal) and salary-band drift cannot be reconstructed retrospectively without a longitudinal archive.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Start weekly snapshotting immediately for the critical/high sources and store raw HTML plus parsed rows so appearance and removal dates are derivable; supplement with Wayback Machine captures of Profesia employer pages for backfill.

coverage_gaps.description: Executive/leadership moves are barely covered by job boards — such roles are filled via executive search, not public postings.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a complementary cell for SK executive-search firms and the NBS/Obchodný register filings on statutory-body changes; boards alone will under-detect leadership moves.

coverage_gaps.description: No RSS/API/structured feed identified for any SK board; robots.txt and ToS posture unchecked.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Check robots.txt and any partner/API offering for Profesia (Alma Career) and the government portal; prefer licensed feeds over scraping for the two highest-volume sources.

brief: Slovak hiring signal for banking and payments is concentrated in a small, highly structured landscape: Profesia.sk is the dominant board and doubles as a pointer layer through stable per-employer C-ID pages, while nearly every major bank also runs its own Slovak-language ATS (topjobs.sk for Slovenská sporiteľňa and 365.bank, kariera.tatrabanka.sk for Tatra/Raiffeisen, vub.sk, csob.sk with LMC's csob.jobs.cz behind it, and kariera.nbs.sk for the regulator). Two state channels — ISTP.sk and the ministry's sluzbyzamestnanosti.gov.sk portal — carry statutorily reported vacancies and are the best low-risk route to branch-level roles that commercial boards under-represent. The main constraints are that no third-party machine-readable ATS endpoints (Workday/SmartRecruiters/SuccessFactors) were confirmed for Slovak bank entities, LinkedIn is auth-walled for the senior and leadership-move signal, and payments vendors have little or no Slovak-language recruiting presence. Because vacancy disappearance is itself the wind-down signal, longitudinal snapshotting must start now rather than being reconstructed later.
